name: Death From Below
objectiveText: Protect Shakes O'Breen during the attack.   Defend Shakes O'Breen  ( 1 )

comments.body:
This quest is ludicrously easy.  It can be performed at the lowest possible level.  Three waves of Naga appear from behind the hill.  One wave of three, one wave of two, and a final wave of three.  They are all level 40.

Pay attention to the Captain, though, swabbie!  He tells you to man the cannon.  Head up the ramp to the ship and find the solitary cannon on the main deck.  Right-clicking on this cannon while standing beside it will one-shot every Naga that appears in one fell swoop.  Wait until the Naga are descending upon the defenders and fire.  Every Naga will die instantly.  After your three waves are done, collect your reward, matey!
replies: Thank you 14 years later! WoW Classic forever!

comments.body:
This is actually pretty easy once you get a handle of what exactly you need to do.

Basically, there's one cannon on top of the ship that you need to fire (I think it's the only one you are able to interact with).  Go on the ship and watch in the direction that the cannon aims.  About 4 waves of naga come up the path and if you fire the cannon when they appear in sight, the cannon kills them outright.  If you do this correctly, the Captain and his crew won't have to fight anything at all.

I just finished this quest.  I talked to Shakes O'Breen and he gave me the quest that started off with "this is bad." ..."The Naga will be coming from the sea.  I need you to remain up here with me to fend off the attack.  Man the cannon and drive them back. Are you ready"
As soon as I accepted the quest I ran up the gang-plank to the ship and ran to the cannon on the main deck (its the one to the right and slightly aft when you get on the ship facing to the rear) and manned the cannon that faces toward a slight saddle back on the hillside.  Once there you will be able to click on the cannon.  The ogre (Lolo the Lookout} that is standing on shore ran up the hill to the saddle-back where the cannon is facing and he waited there for a short time, then he ran back to his normal place.  Also several hands (sailors) repositioned to where the ogre normally stands. very shortly thereafter a Naga appeared at the saddle-back and I fired the cannon. The naga droped dead.  Following the first, more Naga appeared and each time I fired the cannon (from the deck of the ship)and they again dropped dead.  I continued to fire each time a (or group of) Naga appeared and they immediately droped dead.  I continued this until I got the message that the quest was completed.  I did not have to fight hand to hand any Naga.  I only used the cannon.  Got my ring (2 Str, 2 Agi, 10 Sta) and was finished.  Hope this helps to better explain how this quest is easily accomplished.

I just wanted to add that as I stood at that cannon on the ship, looking out at what the previous poster called a "saddle back" -- which is actually a PATH, which comes over a rise, on which the Naga DO come for the "attack" -- as I looked, I did see the Naga from time to time, coming over that rise on the path, for their attack. And my cannon blasts did indeed kill them all!  :-)

Certainly, it all could have been orchestrated by Blizzarda a LOT better for the desired "sea cannon battle effect", but if you go immediately up the plank from the dock, and turn right once you're on the ship's deck, and position yourself behind the ONLY cannon in that area pointing back toward the side you just came up on (also the only cannon with the live "gear" cursor!), you will see that you alone, firing that single cannon repeatedly as soon as the cursor appears each time (maybe 15-18 shots total), are responsible for killing all the attacking Naga.  :-)

And aside from the ring award, 4650 experience is GREAT for something as simple and easy as this!  LOL

Admittedly, without the written descriptions here on Thottbot of what this is and how it "works", I'm sure I never would have seen any Naga, or been the least aware of what the HECK was happening!  heh heh ... or maybe I might have tried to fight them like normal on that path and been killed, who knows!  LOL!

This quest can be done and completed as a group even if only one of you uses the cannon while your party members just stand around. For party members the quest will begin with a confirmation dialog the same as an escort quest. As soon as you start it run up the gangway onto the ship and just stand next to the clickable cannon near the stern. This cannon doesn't function like a vehicle the way we've become accustomed to in later versions of WoW. The cannon is already aimed toward the spawn point. When the naga appear just click the cannon and they'll die.

You don't have to fire the cannon when the naga aren't there.  Just wait till the naga appear at the top of the hill and then fire the cannon.  If you time it right, they'll be blown up.  Just keep doing that until the naga stop coming and you get the Quest Complete signal.

If you miss the naga with your shot, they'll come up to the docks and attack the sailors.  They're pretty capable, so you probably don't need to jump down to help them so long as you're able to kill the next wave with the cannon.
